_comment: Written by the agent each day (3 EN post ideas for the operator). Keep facts and numbers traceable to posts on the board. Short hyphen only, no new numbers.

ideas.title: Agents are waiting for their Kubernetes moment
ideas.hook_en: Agents are waiting for their Kubernetes moment. Anthropic's platform lead lists the missing pieces: agent file systems, sandboxes, runtimes. Manus says its engineering stack went from human-friendly to exposing interfaces to AI. As an ops person, this is the most familiar plot twist in tech.
ideas.video_tip: 12s split screen: left a 2015-style kubectl get pods, right an agent sandbox list; caption morphs 'containers needed an orchestrator' into 'agents need one too'.
ideas.angle: Uses yin min's DevOps / K8s background to frame agent infrastructure as the next platform layer.
ideas.why: A Chinese summary of Anthropic platform lead Katelyn Lesse's piece on agent infrastructure (compared to k8s) reached 29.4K views; Dotey's Manus AI Native org post reached 24.4K; Anthropic's S-1 post reached 7.8M on 26 Oct.

ideas.title: Fix the parser before you blame the memory
ideas.hook_en: New eval: many agent memory systems can't beat naive RAG, even at higher cost. Meanwhile OCR models now swallow entire book series in one pass. The boring layers are winning. If your agent forgets, check parsing and retrieval before you buy another memory framework.
ideas.video_tip: 15s screencast: drop a messy PDF in, show the raw parsed chunks scrolling, highlight one broken table, then a caption 'garbage in, no memory can save it'.
ideas.angle: Second-day take on the RAG-vs-memory debate, moved one layer down to document parsing, which yin min's RAG + Milvus audience feels daily.
ideas.why: XuanHe21's thread on memory systems underperforming naive RAG reached 15.9K views; xiaohu's post on the second-gen Unlimited OCR model reached 50.8K; the RAW-RAG post is at 92.8K.

ideas.title: My assistant now reads X for me
ideas.hook_en: People are swapping Siri for Grok Bot on their iPhones. I went the other way: I gave it the accounts I follow and it now scans their posts every morning, finds what took off, and rebuilds a public dashboard for me. A personal agent should run while you sleep, not only when you call it.
ideas.video_tip: 10s phone screen recording: open the board, scroll the top hits, tap one post, end on the board URL as a lower-third.
ideas.angle: Rides the Grok Bot wave (top keywords Grok / Grok Bot / video) with yin min's own working build as proof.
ideas.why: liyue_ai's Grok Bot-replaces-Siri video reached 134.5K views; Grok and Grok Bot were the #2 and #4 keywords across watchlist posts on 26 Oct.
